High DID byte 0x11 indexes pointer table 0x226ac and normally returns one byte; high byte 0x12 indexes table 0x2289c and normally returns two consecutive bytes in big-endian order. High byte 0x13 indexes eight-byte records at 0x229e0 and returns one runtime byte plus a support-mask byte. Exact entries include 0x1101 -> ffff1079, 0x1107 through 0x110a -> ffff2022, 0x1123 -> ffff22dc, 0x1124 -> ffff22de, 0x1125 -> ffff2302, 0x1126 -> ffff2304, 0x1201 -> ffff11f4, 0x1206 -> ffff23c8, 0x1207 -> ffff23ca, 0x1208 -> ffff1026, 0x1135 -> ffff2442, 0x120f -> ffff2756, 0x1210 -> ffff275e, 0x124b -> ffff285c, 0x124c -> ffff2864, 0x130a -> ffff2c56 with support mask ROM8[0x11a39]=0x10, and 0x130b -> ffff2c57 with support mask ROM8[0x11a3a]=0x03; response SID is 0x62.
note: DID 0x1208 returns newest Base Fuel Schedule word ffff1026. DIDs 0x1107 through 0x110a are exact aliases for one response byte. DIDs 0x1123 through 0x1126 return the high bytes of four Q8.8-percent fuel-trim words. DIDs 0x1211, 0x1212, 0x1127, and 0x1128 select 0xffffffff entries and are rejected. Exact pointer bindings are separated from physical names and units, which come from reviewed diagnostic sources and exact Mode 01 cross-checks.

semantics: Diagnostic status-byte builder. For DID 0x130a byte ffff2c56, bit 4 is set only when ffff24d2 bit 3 is set and ffff4255 bit 3 is clear. For DID 0x130b byte ffff2c57, output bit 1 follows ffff2377 bit 0, while output bit 0 follows ffff2377 bit 1 when ROM8[0x8b2a] bit 2 is clear. The exact DID records supply support masks 0x10 and 0x03.
note: Reviewed Nissan diagnostics identify DID 0x130a bit 4 as THRTL RELAY. A homologous structured Nissan profile identifies DID 0x130b bits 1 and 0 as HO2S2 heater states for banks 1 and 2. The function establishes reported control states, not physical output pins.

semantics: Second-bank paired-sensor conditioning stage. It subtracts two acquisition words ffff363a/ffff363c from 0x0400, writes the second raw diagnostic value ffff2864, subtracts learned offsets ffff561a/ffff561c, clamps signed corrected values, and writes ffff285e/ffff2860.
note: Exact UDS DID 0x124c and reviewed Nissan diagnostics identify ffff2864 as TP SEN 2-B2. The physical scale is supplied by diagnostics, not by this arithmetic alone.

semantics: Paired-sensor selection and inverse-conversion stage. Mode bits select nonnegative corrected sources into ffff284a and ffff284c. Each is multiplied by four, passed through inverse pair 0x13202/0x155a0, averaged, converted through the inverse direction, divided by four, and written to ffff2848. FUN 0003b520 consumes ffff284a/ffff284c in the same two-bank ETC/airflow component.
note: The paired-sensor and inverse-conversion topology is exact. Diagnostic bindings establish throttle-position feedback semantics for the exposed source words; the final motor command remains unresolved.

semantics: Factory diagnostic service-mode dispatcher. When service selector ffff8491 equals 1, it calls FUN_00035856, the Mode 01 PID handler.
note: Other selector values dispatch separate diagnostic services.

semantics: J1979 Mode 01 PID dispatcher. PID 0x04 returns calculated-load byte ffff413e. PIDs 0x06, 0x07, 0x08, and 0x09 read Q8.8-percent words ffff22dc, ffff2302, ffff22de, and ffff2304 respectively, calculate min(255, floor(word/200)), and return one byte.
note: The standard definitions identify PID order 0x06=STFT B1, 0x07=LTFT B1, 0x08=STFT B2, and 0x09=LTFT B2. Division by 200 converts internal percent*256 into the J1979 byte domain, where 100 percent is raw 128. This exact path independently establishes the identities and scale of UDS DIDs 0x1123 through 0x1126.

semantics: Bank-indexed learned-fuel-trim cell selector. It selects one of 64 Q8.8-percent cells from RAM grid ffff4b90 for bank 1 or ffff4b10 for bank 2. The 8x8 index uses current Base Fuel Schedule word ffff1024 against ROM byte thresholds 0x12592 and engine-speed byte ffff11ae against thresholds 0x126dc, with hysteresis around the prior packed index in ffff130a/ffff130b. The selected cell is written to ffff2306 or ffff2308.
note: The RPM thresholds correspond to 0, 1000, 1500, 2200, 3400, 4400, 5400, and 6400 RPM through the established rpm/50 scale of ffff11ae. Exact DID 0x1208 establishes the ffff1024 coordinate as Base Fuel Schedule. An invalid selected cell, a fault flag, or a control gate resets all 64 cells of the affected bank to neutral 0x6400.

semantics: Long-term fuel-trim diagnostic-word producer. For each bank it calculates selected learned word ffff2306/ffff2308 + adjustment ffff5648/ffff564a - 0x6400. Under the normal limiting gate it clamps the result to ROM8[0x8e5b]<<8 through ROM8[0x8e5a]<<8; fault and control gates force neutral 0x6400. It writes ffff2302 for bank 1 or ffff2304 for bank 2.
note: The stock calibrated normal-path range is 90 through 110 percent. UDS DIDs 0x1125/0x1126 return the high bytes; J1979 PIDs 0x07/0x09 convert the complete words.

semantics: Bank-indexed learned-fuel-trim updater. It derives a signed step from Q8.8-percent input ffff134e/ffff1350 relative to neutral 0x6400, an operating-region coefficient, and the current short-term fuel-trim word ffff22dc/ffff22de. It applies the step to selected word ffff2306/ffff2308, clamps the result to 90..110 percent from ROM bytes 0x8a9e/0x8a9f, and writes the selected cell in RAM grid ffff4b90 or ffff4b10.
note: The code establishes adaptive learned-grid maintenance and bank mapping. The physical meaning of the operating-region coefficient and the exact learning cadence remain unresolved.

semantics: Bank-indexed learned-trim adjustment producer. It updates Q8.8-percent word ffff5648 or ffff564a through gated signed steps and calibrated bounds, and forces neutral 0x6400 under fault conditions. FUN 00057b26 combines this adjustment with the selected learned-grid cell to form the LTFT diagnostic word.
note: The exact update arithmetic is code-established, but the narrower operating-mode name for this adjustment term remains unresolved.

semantics: Two-bank fuel-trim coordinator. Under its global enable gates it selects learned-grid cells and builds LTFT outputs for banks 1 and 2, then runs the bank-specific learning and adjustment stages in identical order.
note: The coordinator proves that parameter 0 is bank 1 and parameter 1 is bank 2 by their downstream standard PID and UDS destinations. Its scheduler entry is indirect and remains outside the direct call graph.

semantics: Fuel-trim initialization path. It writes neutral Q8.8-percent value 0x6400 to STFT words ffff22dc/ffff22de and LTFT words ffff2302/ffff2304 during the broader control-state initialization called from FUN 0002c648.
note: The four values share the same neutral representation. Runtime producers replace the diagnostic words after initialization.

semantics: Short-term fuel-trim diagnostic-word producer. It calls FUN 0005cbec, then normally copies working Q8.8-percent words ffff40ac/ffff40ae to ffff22dc/ffff22de. In an alternate control mode it writes one forced byte shifted left by 8 to both banks after clamping it to 75..125 percent.
note: The normal path preserves fractional Q8.8 content. UDS DIDs return only the high bytes, while Mode 01 conversion uses the complete words. The upstream closed-loop arithmetic is retained separately in FUN 0005cbec.

semantics: Two-bank closed-loop correction calculation called immediately before STFT publication. Its final working Q8.8-percent results are written to ffff40ac and ffff40ae; FUN 0005c910 copies them to the bank 1 and bank 2 STFT diagnostic words on the normal path.
note: The function contains the full feedback-control state calculation. This annotation establishes the output role and bank routing without assigning unresolved physical names to its internal terms.

semantics: State-monitor path that uses ffff1062 as an unsigned tolerance. Under its entry gates, it tests abs((ffff1062<<2)-ffff1fa4) < 128 before updating monitor state; ffff1fa4 is then refreshed from ffff1026.
note: The exact tolerance role is proven, but the monitored physical quantity remains unresolved.

semantics: Calculated-load byte producer. It interpolates M from uint16 map 0x1491a by uint8[ffff11b3]<<8, calculates q=floor((uint16[ffff1024]<<8)/M), optionally recalculates q=floor((q<<7)/uint8[ffff329f]) when ROM8[0x870e] bit 4 is set, clamps q to 255, and writes ffff413e.
note: Entry gates can force output 0 or 255. A zero optional divisor also forces 255. FUN_00035856 returns ffff413e for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x04.

semantics: Coolant snapshot-byte producer. It converts ffff1186 through the same 00012dea lookup used for raw coolant response ffff1079, subtracts 10 from the unsigned result with lower saturation at zero, and writes ffff3fa4.
note: Because ffff1079 is the exact UDS DID 0x1101 source with deg C = raw-50, ffff3fa4 code 0 represents at most -40 deg C and each positive code represents deg C = code-40.

semantics: Accessor for shared uint16 addition 00023824. The lookup is conditionally limited below at 46, written to ffff2eba, and separately added with saturation to ffff2c4e and ffff2c50, forming ffff303c and ffff303e.
note: The physical quantity and units of the addition are unresolved.

semantics: NATS Lock state handler: sets bit 2 of 0xffff4201 when a counter reaches its threshold; adjacent branches service related status and DTC states.
note: The Lock state belongs to registration and diagnostics and is not engine inhibit bit 1 of 0xffff4198.

semantics: Two-channel NATS registration handler: forms registered channel 0 in bit 0 of 0xffff41c1 and channel 1 in bit 6 of 0xffff41c2 from evaluator results and attempt counters.
note: Registered states are not part of the confirmed developer-immobilizer execution chain.

semantics: Evaluator for two NATS registration channels: processes counters and input-state quality thresholds for FUN_000937dc.
note: This function does not perform bytewise cryptographic ID verification.

semantics: Primary developer-immobilizer state machine. Reads bit 0 of ROM 0x8725 and updates internal states 0xffff3e28, 0xffff4230, 0xffff55e4, and 0xffff4198.
Developer-immobilizer state normalizer. When bit 0 of ROM 0x8725 is 0, it bypasses state-machine transitions and clears bit 2 of 0xffff55e4 before forming the engine inhibit.
Forms bit 1 of 0xffff4198, the developer-immobilizer engine inhibit, from bit 0 of ROM 0x8725 and states 0xffff3e28, bit 2 of 0xffff55e4, and bit 0 of 0xffff4251.
Sequential dispatcher for the developer-immobilizer state machine: BBC88 -> BC00E -> BC220 -> BC388 -> BC82E -> BC9E4.
note: Ordering BC82E before BC9E4 clears intermediate state before the inhibit is calculated.

semantics: ATU-II/APC engine-event driver and mode dispatcher. It dispatches selector ffff13b2 values 0, 4, 6, 7, 8, and 9. When bit 1 of ffff4198 is clear, it forms a one-bit current-cylinder mask in ffff13d1, updates POPCR fffff700, and calls scheduler feeder 000208f8 on the admitted path. In selector mode 9, a valid previous-capture latch causes abs(ICR0A - ffff84d4) to be written to ffff1dac and ffff84f2.bit7 to be set. Stock selector constants 9/9 make the same invocation refresh ffff84d4 from ICR0A and set ffff84f1.bit7.
note: The first selector-9 capture seeds the reference and every subsequent invocation produces an interval between consecutive ICR0A captures. The selector producer, physical mode names, TI0A signal source, and captures per crankshaft revolution remain unresolved.

semantics: ATU-II/APC engine-event configuration driver. When bit 1 of 0xffff4198 is set, it skips the primary timer-configuration block and clears 0xffff13d1; the enabled path passes the cylinder mask to POPCR 0xfffff700.
Developer-immobilizer monitor: reads bit 0 of ROM 0x8725 and engine inhibit bit 1 of 0xffff4198 for diagnostic state.
note: The diagnostic path is not the only inhibit consumer.

semantics: ATU-II channel 1A GR1E capture-processing path for the second intake-cam channel. It derives a byte from the captured timer value and conditionally writes ffff22cd.
note: The SH7059 hardware manual identifies 0xfffff44c as GR1E. Code proves the capture-derived byte path but not a physical degree conversion.

semantics: ATU-II channel 1A GR1F capture-processing path for the first intake-cam channel. It derives a byte from the captured timer value and conditionally writes ffff22cc.
note: The SH7059 hardware manual identifies 0xfffff44e as GR1F. Code proves the capture-derived byte path but not a physical degree conversion.

semantics: Per-channel signed additive-correction producer for the compensated injection-pulse calculation. The function writes one element of the six-word array at ffff1396+2*i.
note: Several upstream calibrated calculations feed this correction; their individual physical decomposition remains unresolved.

semantics: Two-channel base-pulse producer. Calls with indices 0 and 1 calculate and write unsigned base terms ffff191c and ffff191e, which FUN 0004eba2 selects by channel parity.
note: The trace proves parity reuse across six channels but not the physical bank-to-cylinder order.

semantics: Compensated six-channel injection-pulse writer. For channel i, a set ffff22e0 bit selects override ffff2436. Otherwise it selects base ffff191c/ffff191e by parity, adds signed ffff1396+2*i, conditionally subtracts signed ffff1466+2*i, multiplies a positive result by ROM8[000129c0+i], shifts right by 7, and saturates to uint16. The raw result is written to ffff23c8+2*i and a transformed result to ffff23d4+2*i.
note: Stock ROM8[00008d92]=0x7a enables the subtractive correction. All six multiplier cells are 0x80, or 1.0 in Q1.7. Channel order is proven; physical cylinder order is not.

semantics: Driver for the compensated injection outputs. It calculates the two base terms through FUN 0004ead4, then calls FUN 0004eba2 for channel indices 0..5.
note: The call topology establishes exactly two parity bases and six output channels.

semantics: Per-channel subtractive-correction accumulator. When the supplied channel mask is enabled by ffff1220, it adds a calculated signed term to ffff1466+2*i with signed saturation and copies the paired working value from ffff2424+2*i to ffff195e+2*i.
note: The physical decomposition of the accumulated correction remains unresolved.

semantics: Producer of unsigned override pulse word ffff2436. It applies a fixed-point calculation, shifts through FUN 000224f8, saturates to uint16, and writes the result.
note: The mode that selects this override is represented by the per-channel aggregate mask ffff22e0.

semantics: Six-channel correction-state maintenance path. For selected channels it clears ffff1466+2*i, then either copies a fallback word into ffff195e+2*i or scales the current ffff195e element by ROM8[000085f7]/256.
note: The selected-channel masks are code-traced; the physical decomposition of the correction state remains unresolved.

semantics: Initializes intake-cam reference bytes ffff4799 and ffff479a from ROM bytes 0x831c and 0x8321.
Two-bank intake CVTC control-loop dispatcher. It calls FUN 000bd9f0 for channel indices 0 and 1, updates reference state through FUN 000bdf5c, and invokes paired downstream control calculations.
note: The exact runtime writer and two-bank topology are established independently of diagnostic naming.

semantics: Runtime writer of centered intake-cam timing bytes ffff2442 and ffff2443. For channel i, the normal path writes clamp_u8(0x80 + ffff4799[i] - ffff22cc[i]); a hardware-control mask can force neutral 0x80. A zero enable byte ffff11de suppresses the update.
note: Code proves the centered byte calculation. Homologous diagnostics support the physical intake-cam identity and candidate conversion raw*0.5-64 degCA.

semantics: Two-bank intake-cam reference updater. It conditionally adjusts or restores ffff4799 and ffff479a from centered differences involving capture-derived channel bytes and ROM-backed reference values.
note: The function maintains the reference side of the centered runtime value; exact physical adaptation semantics remain unresolved.

semantics: Engine-speed representation producer. It reads current word ffff11e8, shifts right by 4, saturates to 255, and writes byte ffff11eb. Since FUN 000384fe writes ffff11e8 = ffff1196>>3, the result is min(255, ffff1196>>7).
note: Scheduler 00020dfe copies ffff11eb to ffff11b3. Relative to RPM/50 ffff11ae from the same source, this establishes RPM/25 at ffff11b3.

semantics: Common engine-speed representation producer. From word ffff1196 it writes ffff11e8 = source>>3, ffff11f4 = source>>6, and current byte ffff11e6 = min(255, source>>8), then calls FUN 000384cc to produce current byte ffff11eb = min(255, source>>7).
note: Scheduler 00020dfe exposes RPM/50 at ffff11ae and RPM/25 at ffff11b3. The exact shift ratios establish RPM/12.5 at ffff11f4, which UDS DID 0x1201 returns.

semantics: Engine-coolant-temperature index normalizer. It reads raw DID 0x1101 byte ffff1079. Raw below 10 writes 0 to ffff1077; raw 10..169 writes floor(240*(raw-10)/150); raw at least 170 writes 255.
note: With the homologous DID conversion deg C = raw-50, implicit lookup nodes 0,16,...240 correspond exactly to -40,-30,...110 deg C.

semantics: Vehicle-speed smoothing path. It reads current CAN-derived word ffff113c, applies a first-order filter into ffff115e, then returns a divided and saturated derivative while preserving ffff115e for FUN 0003a254.
note: The exact source of ffff113c is CAN 0x280 bytes 4 and 5. Homologous Z34 CAN data identifies that field as vehicle speed.

semantics: Coarse vehicle-speed producer. When enabled, it divides filtered word ffff115e by 20, saturates the result to 255, and writes byte ffff118e.
note: Scheduler 00020dfe copies ffff118e to ffff110e. Combined with the homologous CAN scale, one byte count is approximately 2 km/h; zero unambiguously means stationary.

semantics: Analog-derived byte producer. It reads the AN0 acquisition result, runs it through conversion helpers, saturates the result to 255, and writes ffff1188.
note: The hardware source is SH7058 ADC channel AN0 at MCU pin 86/H17. The ECM terminal and physical sensor name remain unresolved.

semantics: Over Run Fuel Cut state machine. Parameter 1 is the cut request from FUN 0004fbe2 and parameter 2 is the restore/inhibit state from FUN 00050018. From idle state, a nonzero cut request with zero restore state starts the timed transition through states 1, 2, and 3. A nonzero restore state cancels the pre-cut transition, and later state logic controls the output mask returned to FUN 0004ed88.
note: Additional timing and branch calibrations control transition delays, but the cut versus restore parameter roles and state-machine placement are code-established.

semantics: ASCD control task and steering-switch decoder. It copies prior stable code ffff2a85 to ffff2a86, accepts a new stable code only when samples ffff2701..ffff2705 all match, and packs diagnostic bytes ffff2a83 for DID 0x130D and ffff2a84 for DID 0x130E.
note: The five-sample buffer producer remains unresolved. The homologous VQ35HR factory manual establishes an analog resistor ladder at ECM terminal M107-101, but the exact JK08A ADC channel and MCU pin are not traced.

semantics: Exact P1564 ASCD steering-switch monitor. It reads stable switch code ffff2a85, uses mask 0x1A for CANCEL, SET, and RESUME states and mask 0xC0 for invalid upper codes, and dispatches exact DTC descriptor index 0x7E.
note: Descriptor record 0x19948 contains P1564. Exact fault timing and enable conditions remain in the surrounding monitor state machine.

semantics: Startup configuration initializer. It preserves ffff4247 and ORs bit 4, then initializes service 0x22 support masks ffff2a81 for DID 0x130D and ffff2a82 for DID 0x130E from ROM configuration byte 0x8B28. The first mask is 0x00, 0x3F, 0x31, or 0x7F; the second is 0x00, 0x3F, or 0x04.
note: The write proves that existing ffff4247 bits are retained and bit 4 is forced on; it does not source bit 6. The support masks do not prove the physical option set encoded by ROM8[0x8B28].

semantics: CAN 0x280 vehicle-speed receive path. It assembles bytes 4 and 5 as big-endian uint16, treats 0xffff as invalid, otherwise divides by 10, and writes ffff113c.
note: Homologous observed Z34 CAN data identifies frame 0x280 bytes 4 and 5 as vehicle speed with approximate raw/100 km/h scaling. The exact firmware division produces 0.1 km/h units at ffff113c before filtering.

semantics: Bank-indexed rear O2 monitor coordinator. Its initialization path writes 0 to ffff26e9[bank], ffff26eb[bank], and ffff2726[bank], writes 0xff to ffff2724[bank], manages the surrounding enable state, and calls FUN 00089d92 for fault dispatch.
note: The monitor values are bank-indexed bytes. Their physical voltage or time scales are not established.

semantics: Rear O2 complementary status path. For each bank it compares ffff26e9/ffff26eb with 0x80, ffff2726 with 0x24, and ffff2724 with 0xff, then calls FUN 000b4ef8 with descriptor indices 0xa7..0xac on the complementary outcomes.
note: This function does not call the common fault dispatcher at 0007d8b8; no pass/fail label is assigned to FUN 000b4ef8 here.

semantics: Primary bank-indexed rear O2 fault dispatcher. It dispatches indices 0xa7/0xa8 for P0139/P0159 when either ffff26e9[bank] or ffff26eb[bank] is below 0x80, 0xab/0xac for P0137/P0157 when ffff2726[bank] is below 0x24, and 0xa9/0xaa for the path-A P0138/P0158 descriptors when ffff2724[bank] reaches 0xff.
note: Descriptor records establish the rear O2 fault identities. The internal byte scales and all surrounding enable/timing conditions remain unresolved.

semantics: Alternate bank-indexed rear O2 high-voltage monitor. It maintains two calibrated working bytes at ffff42b0[bank] and ffff42b2[bank], sets a fault condition when either working byte is zero under its gates, and dispatches indices 0xad/0xae for the path-B P0138/P0158 descriptors.
note: The stock reload value is 5. The cadence and physical interpretation of the two working bytes are not established.

semantics: Rear O2 monitor reset path. For the selected bank it clears ffff26e9, ffff26eb, and ffff2726, restores ffff2724 to 0xff, and resets adjacent diagnostic state.
note: This reset path confirms the array widths and bank indexing but not their physical units.

semantics: Independent catalyst-efficiency result dispatcher. It selects bank 1 or bank 2 from runtime state and calls the common fault dispatcher with descriptor index 0x11 or 0x12, which the exact JK08A catalog identifies as P0420 or P0430.
note: The upstream efficiency calculation and physical threshold remain in the surrounding catalyst-monitor subsystem.

semantics: Bank-specific catalyst-monitor metric accumulator. It scales ffff3300[bank] by ROM8[0x8b0b] or ROM8[0x8b0c], accumulates a saturated uint16 sum at ffff3336+2*bank, increments sample count ffff3187[bank], divides the sum by the count, caps the result at 255, and writes ffff314d[bank]. A zero count writes 0xff.
note: Code establishes the averaging and saturation path. The physical quantity and units remain unresolved.

semantics: Catalyst-monitor limit producer. For an enabled bank it interpolates 1D-8 uint8 table 0x11fb6 by saturated RPM/12.5 byte ffff11b2 and writes the result to ffff2b6f[bank].
note: All eight stock table cells are zero. The output physical quantity and unit remain unresolved.

semantics: Bank-indexed catalyst-monitor branch. Under its enable state it compares metric ffff314d[bank] with calibrated limit ffff2b6f[bank] and dispatches descriptor 0x11 or 0x12 when the unsigned metric is below the limit. Other branches call FUN 000b4ef8 with the same indices.
note: Table 0x11fb6 yields zero throughout the stock ROM, so unsigned ffff314d[bank] < ffff2b6f[bank] is impossible in this branch. FUN 000a2254 provides an independent P0420/P0430 dispatch path.

semantics: Per-bank emissions-monitor dispatcher. It first calls rear O2 heater command-state observer FUN 000a25fa. Its gated catalyst sequence then updates the accumulator, produces metric ffff314d through FUN 000a2d66, produces calibrated limit ffff2b6f through FUN 000a2ee4, and evaluates the P0420/P0430 branch through FUN 000a2f56.
note: The call topology closes one calibrated catalyst-monitor branch and the heater command-state observation point; it does not replace the independent catalyst result path through FUN 000a2254 or prove a physical heater output.

semantics: Rear O2 heater circuit-diagnostic coordinator. Exact configuration gates select each bank, calls at 0x8b65a and 0x8b7c6 invoke FUN 0008b93a for banks 1 and 2, and later paths snapshot the corresponding ffff2722/ffff2723 feedback bytes into mode-indexed history storage.
note: The coordinator consumes the feedback bytes but does not directly produce them.

semantics: Bank-indexed rear O2 heater circuit monitor. Under its exact enable gates it compares ffff2722[bank] with ROM8[0x8aaf]=0x0c and ROM8[0x8ab0]=0xec. A value below 0x0c dispatches descriptor 0xb1 or 0xb2 for P0037/P0057; a value at or above 0xec dispatches descriptor 0xaf or 0xb0 for P0038/P0058. In-range state reloads the monitor byte at ffff4293[bank] from ROM8[0x8ab2]=5.
note: Code establishes the threshold and descriptor selection. A whole-program p-code scan found no direct writer for ffff2722, so its producer and physical current or voltage scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Per-bank rear O2 heater command-state observer called by FUN 000a38dc. It tests ffff2377 bit 0 for bank 1 or bit 1 for bank 2, updates the corresponding ffff3298 latch bit, and clears ffff4295[bank] to ROM8[0x8ab1]=0 when the command bit is inactive.
note: The command-state bit names come from the exact DID 0x130b packing path and a homologous structured Nissan profile. No direct writer for ffff2377 or physical output driver is resolved.

semantics: Common DTC fault-state dispatcher. Its byte argument indexes the exact 12-byte descriptor catalog, invokes descriptor-specific status handling, and records the active result. Descriptor byte 8 bit 6 routes directly to FUN 0007dc32; all seven exact P0306..P0300 descriptors carry byte 8 value 0x40 and therefore use that path. Descriptor pairs 0xd8/0xd9 and 0xda/0xdb receive grouped handling for the leak-monitor families.
note: This is the fault-producing dispatcher used by the traced misfire and EVAP branches. FUN 000b4ef8 is the distinct complementary state updater.

semantics: Generic table-driven DTC monitor with 0x38-byte entries rooted at ROM 0x23ac4. Entry 6 at 0x23c14 tests word fffff754 with mask 0x0004, requires low mode bits of ffff1098 to equal 1, uses state byte ffff4348, and dispatches descriptor index 0xd7 through FUN 0007d8b8.
note: Descriptor record 0x19d74 identifies entry 6 as path-B P0447. Its only caller, FUN 000a6fee, skips entry 6 in stock JK08A because ROM8[0x18700].bit0 is clear.

semantics: Configuration-gated caller for table-driven monitor FUN 000a6dc4. ROM8[0x186dc].bit7 selects entry 0 and ROM8[0x18700].bit0 selects entry 6.
note: Both selected bits are clear in stock JK08A. A whole-program call scan found no other caller of FUN 000a6dc4, so the path-B P0447 entry is statically unreachable in the stock image.

semantics: Path-A P0447 status producer inside the EVAP vent-control monitor. With ffff15d3 equal to 0x80 it increments timer ffff2d30 and computes the nonnegative high-byte difference between baseline ffff2e91 shifted by 8 and sample word ffff10c4. When the timer exceeds ROM8[0x8370]=0x50 it sets ffff247a bit 6.
note: FUN 000abca2 consumes bit 6 through FUN 000aacc0 and dispatches exact path-A descriptor index 0x31 for P0447. The coordinator skips this monitor in stock JK08A; the sample scale and physical terminal remain unresolved.

semantics: Purge-control circuit status producer. The ROM8[0x186fe].bit2 branch debounces its condition for ROM8[0x84fc]=0x32 counts and sets ffff423e bit 0 for P0444. The bit1 branch can set ffff423f bit 7 for P0445 after the same debounce.
note: ROM8[0x186fe]=0 disables both branches in stock JK08A. Even if the P0445 configuration bit were enabled, its recovered producer requires unsigned ffff404a < ROM8[0x850a]=0 and remains unreachable with the stock threshold.

semantics: EVAP diagnostic coordinator. It calls the subsystem monitors, consumes one-shot status bits, and invokes FUN 0007d8b8 for descriptor indices 0xc9 P0444, 0xca P0445, 0x2e P0443, 0xd4 P0452, 0xd5 P0453, 0xd6 P0441, 0x31 path-A P0447, and 0x2f P0448.
note: The descriptor identities and dispatcher sites are exact, but the stock configuration skips all eight branches. The separate P0451 call at 0xabf96 remains outside those configuration gates. Each consumed status bit is cleared after handling.

semantics: EVAP pressure-sensor circuit status producer called by FUN 000ac994. Under the common ffff2736 and ffff10f9 gates, timer ffff2fd6 below ROM8[0x8553]=0x16 sets ffff247e bit 6 for P0452, while a timer at or above ROM8[0x8552]=0xfe sets bit 5 for P0453.
